title: Key Questions on Energy and AI
attributed_claim_summary: IEA published updated analysis of electricity demand, data-centre investment, grid constraints and energy security under rapid AI expansion.
evidence_or_event: Original IEA report published April 16, 2026 (licensed CC BY 4.0); system-wide scenario and analysis, not a measurement of software reuse in this project.
limitations: Macro electricity demand scenarios do not supply provider-specific joules per coding token or net carbon impact of any individual implementation; embodied hardware and workload rebound remain boundary questions.
research_relevance: Keep energy and carbon measurement scoped to independently accepted equivalent tasks, observed local/CI consumption and explicit cloud-inference unknowns.
practical_experiment: Instrument power draw of two functionally equivalent local/CI task workflows under identical hardware; report uncertainty and explicitly unmeasured provider inference, upkeep and lifetime effects.
